title: Wolf
wikitext:
[[image:wolf.png|right|/chomp]]
A carnivorous, furry, [[canine]] [[beast]] that often runs in packs. Wolves are known to be unable to [[Swim|swim]] (at least in [[World of Warcraft]]).  Wolves encountered in the wilderness are typically [[hostile]] and [[aggro|attack]] characters that approach them too [[Aggro_Radius|closely]].

Wolves are indigenous to many parts of Azeroth. The live in [[Elwynn Forest]], the [[Hinterlands]], [[Mulgore]], [[Duskwood]], [[Silverpine Forest]], the [[Badlands]], [[Tirisfal Glades]], [[Dun Morogh]], [[Felwood]], [[Burning Steppes]], [[Ashenvale]], [[Feralas]], the [[Western Plaguelands]], [[Blackrock Spire]], and [[Shadowfang Keep]].  They have a wide variety of sub-species and social habits. Though
most wolves are [[hostile]] towards humans and demi-humans who encroach upon their territories, a few unique dire wolf packs have befriended the Horde in recent years. There is a larger variety of wolf called [[Worg]]s; these are used as the [[orc]] [[mount]]. [[Orc]] [[shamans]] seem to hold them in high regard evidenced by the fact that their armor often has a wolf on them.

=== Game Value ===
* At least some wolves start with the [[Bite]] special ability when tamed as [[hunter]] [[pet]]s.
* Wolves are [[skinnable]].

=== Examples ===
* Snow Tracker Wolf ([[Dun Morogh]])
* Plains Tracker ([[Mulgore]])
* [[Coyote]] ([[Westfall]])

== [[Ghost Wolf]] ==
[[Shaman]] of moderate ability can change their form into a [[Ghost Wolf]]. This allows them to travel much faster than an average humanoid, but this ritual only works outdoors.

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Has medium damage, medium armor, and medium HP.
* Eats only Meat.
* Can learn [[Growl]], [[Cower]], [[Dash]], [[Bite]], and their own skill, [[Furious Howl]].
* The Mist Howler, Prairie Wolf Alpha, Deathmaw, Slavering Worg, Bloodaxe Worg, and Mist Howler are relatively popular for their faster swing speeds.  
* A popular pet, due to a variety of colors, some wolves with fast swing speed, Furious Howl, and Dash.
* Worgs, when tamed as a hunter pet, are in the same category as wolves and have the same skills.

== Epic Mount ==
[[image:EpicWolf.png|thumb|]]
The epic wolf is buyable in [[Orgrimmar]] in the Valley of Honor just outside the Hunter Trainer's building.  The PvP mount is the Black War Wolf.  A famous variety of the epic wolf is the [[Frostwolf]] - a huge, rideable wolf availible to members of the [[Horde]] exalted with the [[Frostwolf Clan]].
